name: Meal Dynamics
shortDescription: Enterprise-scale food service management platform. I lead its frontend development at Bajco Technologies.
overview: Meal Dynamics is an enterprise-scale food service management platform. I lead its frontend development, building reusable, modular components and custom directives, and integrating with RESTful APIs built on ASP.NET/.NET while working with backend developers, QA engineers, designers and business stakeholders.

name: Fleet Management System (FMS)
shortDescription: IoT-enabled fleet management platform with real-time GPS vehicle tracking and operational dashboards.
overview: Enterprise-scale Fleet Management System built at HyperNym. I developed IoT-enabled frontend modules and interactive dashboards for real-time vehicle tracking, fleet monitoring and operational analytics, on reusable Angular components and a modular UI architecture.

name: SCAD Census
shortDescription: Real-time census and demographic dashboards for the Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi, in English and Arabic.
overview: Enterprise-scale web application for the Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi (SCAD) that visualizes and analyzes real-time census and demographic data across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, giving government stakeholders accurate, real-time insight for planning and decision-making.
keyFeatures: Interactive dashboards and reports for population statistics, labor force, housing, real estate and other key indicators
Responsive, multilingual (English/Arabic) interfaces with RTL support
